rules.description: Allow standards-based OAuth/MCP clients and public listing checks
rules.expression: (http.host eq "outray.co" and (http.request.uri.path in {"/contact" "/privacy" "/terms" "/plugins/codex" "/api/mcp"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/mcp/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/auth/")))
